rows.text: Leo has swim lessons every Tuesday at 17:30-18:15 at the Pam McConnell Aquatic Centre (640 Dundas St E, Regent Park), starting 30 Sep 2025.
Open to-do for Riya: get passport photos for Leo.

Riya works at Lumen Pay on payouts (planning Q4 2025: reconciliation CSV export v2, payout status webhooks, instant payout fee experiment; ~2.5 engineers; bank partner API migration risk in November). Colleagues include Aisha Rahman, Diego, Wen, Olivia and manager-level contact Tom.
Sam (Sam Okafor) is Riya's partner; they live together with Leo.
When writing to or for Tom, give one recommendation plus one alternative, not an open-ended list of options (Tom responds much better).

Leo takes piano with Mrs. Greene every Monday 16:30-17:15 at her home on Pape Avenue (from Mon 6 Oct 2025).

Travel preference: for family trips to Ottawa Riya always prefers driving the Mazda over the train, leaving early Friday to beat 401 traffic, with a stop at the Big Apple in Colborne (Leo treats it as a rule). Use for Christmas planning. Toronto (Leslieville) to Ottawa Glebe is about 452 km, 4 h 35 min without traffic.
Sam gets migraines from strong fragrances, so Riya's home has no scented candles or air fresheners; avoid scented gifts (candles, soaps, perfume) for the household.

To do before the cold: book the snow tire swap for the Mazda (options found: Leslieville Auto Service Fri 24 Oct 8:30 $70; Kal Tire Eastern Ave Sat 25 Oct 9:00 or 11:30 $79.95; Canadian Tire Leslie St Wed 22 Oct 18:00 $89.99); none booked yet as of 11 Oct 2025. Appointments fill up in late October.

Plan: Northline Renovations cabinet delivery Thu 16 Oct 2025, 8:00-10:00; someone must be home to let the crew in.
Grace and Daniel hosted Riya's family for Thanksgiving 2025 in Ottawa (Glebe area); Grace bakes (four pies), Daniel is a civil engineer.
As of Tue 14 Oct 2025 Riya had not reached her mother Anjali since the weekend (no answer to calls or texts) and was worried; she planned to try Anjali's cousin. Anjali's phone often dies.
Jun Cho is Leo's best friend and Hannah Cho's son; Leo and Jun walk to Morse Street PS together most mornings.
Writing style: Riya dislikes salesy, press-release hype (exclamation marks, 'game-changing', DM pitches). Prefers calm, concrete wording with one specific change and real names credited.

Class snack: it is Leo's turn to bring the class snack to Ms. Alvarez's grade 2 class on Fri 17 Oct 2025 (22 students; label everything with ingredients). Ordered PC Express order PCX-77310452 at Real Canadian Superstore, 17 Leslie St, pickup Thu 16 Oct 17:30-18:00, $40.47.

Riya Malhotra's Q4 2025 onboarding goal at Lumen Pay: lift signup -> first payout conversion from 41% to 48% by end of Q4. Biggest drop-offs: KYC document upload (22% drop, mostly mobile, 'proof of address'), bank verification micro-deposit wait of 1-2 business days, and merchant confusion at the 'payout schedule' step. Experiments: E14 instant bank verification (50% of new signups, started 2025-10-06) and E15 reordered steps, business details before personal ID (started 2025-10-13). Compliance says no to skipping KYC for merchants under $1k/month.

Early E14 (instant bank verification) read on 2025-10-19: 47.1% conversion vs control 41.9%, but inflated by an Android kyc_submitted double-fire (~6% duplicates since 2025-10-08, ticket ONB-212, owner Aisha). Do not quote the E14 lift until the fix is applied. E15 reorder arm: 44.0% vs 43.7% control after 1 week, not significant.

Riya's onboarding and payouts colleagues at Lumen Pay: Aisha Rahman (engineering, Bank rails tickets such as ONB-212, PAY-352, PAY-355), Diego Fernandez (design and copy, Figma, Merchant UI, payout schedule copy), Wen Li (data and Looker analysis, E14 metrics), Tom Becker (senior stakeholder, optional attendee at reviews, roadmap pre-reads and dry runs), Mo (owns PAY-344 negative-balance recovery), Olivia Grant (sales, asks about instant payouts timing for prospects).

Riya lives in Leslieville, Toronto (postal area M4M) with her partner Sam Okafor and their six-year-old son Leo (Grade 2 at Morse Street PS, Ms. Alvarez's class). The household has a beagle named Biscuit.

Outside tap at the back of Riya's house is dripping and could freeze. On 2025-10-19 she planned to call Riverside Drain & Plumbing (4.7, Broadview Ave, 24/7 emergency) on 2025-10-20. Alternatives found: East End Plumbing Co. (4.8, Queen St E, service call $129, frost-free hose bib replacement from $285 installed, openings Tue 21 Oct 8-10 and Wed 22 Oct 13-15) and Coxwell Plumbing & Heating (4.6). A frost-free replacement is better than a washer fix. A plumber was later fixing it (Nov 2025).

Riya takes Spanish lessons with her tutor Carlos Mendez every Thursday at 19:30, $45 per lesson ($180 for 4 lessons). Her recurring mistakes, saved in Notes / Spanish: ser vs estar (emotions, locations), por vs para, and the subjunctive after 'cuando' for future events (cuando llegue, not cuando llego). Wants to be quizzed on these.
Toronto Hydro is paid by autopay from the TD joint account (bill $142.18 for 2025-09-12 to 2025-10-11, due 2025-10-30). No action needed on the hydro bill.

Every Friday by 16:00 Riya posts the payouts status update in #payouts-launch: five bullets with red/amber/green for each workstream. A recurring reminder is set Fridays 15:00-15:30 (starts 2025-10-24). Pre-draft the update from Linear for her to edit.
Friday evening is pizza and movie night at home, 18:00-21:00: Leo picks the movie and Sam makes the pizza dough. Keep Friday evenings clear (calendar event marked busy, starts 2025-10-24).

Riya finished her first half marathon, the Toronto Waterfront Half Marathon (21K), on 2025-10-19 with an official chip time of 2:04:37. Her friend Marcus trained with her every week. Saved in Notes / Health 'Running log'.

Riya's Costco Executive membership ($130/yr) renews 2025-11-18. She made only 5 trips in the last year ($1,141.20 total), earned $22.82 in the 2% reward, and Gold Star is $65/yr. Recommendation given: downgrade to Gold Star before 18 Nov rather than cancel. Riya has not decided yet.

Sam Okafor is Riya's partner and Leo's other parent. He teaches at Riverdale Collegiate Institute (Gerrard St E), room 214, makes the pizza dough on Fridays, and has edit access to the family photo albums.

Marcus Bell is Riya's friend and running partner who trained with her weekly for the half marathon. His sister is moving to Calgary in January 2026 with her husband and a toddler; she wants a walkable, not-crazy-expensive neighbourhood (suggested Bridgeland-Riverside, Killarney-Glengarry, Mount Pleasant, Tuscany).

Riya wants a proper yearly running recap in December: calendar reminder Sun 2025-12-28 10:00 to build the 2025 running recap from Notes / Running log (entries so far: Toronto Waterfront Half Marathon 2025-10-19, 2:04:37).

Riya's mother Anjali lives in Bandra (Bandra West), Mumbai. Her household helper is Sunita; Riya sent her a festival bonus of about 15,000 INR in Nov 2025 (about $236.59 CAD at 1 CAD = 63.4 INR on 2025-11-01).
Kabir is a family member (in the family chat) whose daughter Ira took her first steps on 2025-11-02.
E14 (instant bank verification) lift after the ONB-212 Android double-fire fix: +4.3 pts (was +5.2 before the fix), per Wen on 2025-11-02. Use the corrected number when reporting.

Leo's passport expires in January 2026 and Riya wants to renew it. Simplified child renewal: form PPTC 482, two identical photos (one signed by a guarantor), current passport, $57 for 5 years; one parent can sign; 10 business days in person, 20 by mail; child need not attend. Appointment options found: Service Canada 25 St. Clair Ave E (Thu 13 Nov 10:20, Mon 17 Nov 11:40), Scarborough Town Centre (Wed 12 Nov 9:50, Sat 15 Nov 10:10); photo studios: Queen East Photo & Print ($17.99), Shoppers Queen & Carlaw ($15.99), Gerrard Photo Studio ($22). Booking link in Notes / Leo passport. Nothing booked yet.

Household finances: monthly household budget is $4,600 (October 2025 came in at $4,812, mostly groceries and a $189 Halloween/party run). The kitchen renovation has a $48,000 budget tracked in its own account. Bills on autopay include Toronto Hydro and Rogers mobile ($118.40, around the 6th); Visa ending 4417.

Riya's personal inbox: promo emails were mass-unsubscribed on 2025-11-02 (31 of 38 senders); three senders needing a login (Old Navy, Cineplex, Air Miles) are saved in Notes / Inbox cleanup. A filter now auto-labels receipts as 'Receipts'. Skip transactional senders and real people when cleaning up (Toronto Hydro, Presto, Service Ontario, TD Alerts).

Riya's writing style rules (Notes / Work): no em dashes in her drafts, use commas or full stops instead, every time; say 'merchant', not 'customer' or 'user', in payouts docs; short paragraphs, no more than 3 sentences.

October 2025 onboarding funnel: 9,574 signups, 7,402 KYC complete, 5,233 bank verified, 4,218 first payout (44.1% conversion); weekly conversion rose from 41.2% (wk of Sep 29) to 45.6% (partial wk of Oct 27). Numbers use the corrected Android event (ONB-212 fix applied retroactively). Goal is 48% by end of Q4.

Northbridge Bank (contact Katalin Varga) proposed moving the same-day settlement cutoff for Lumen Pay payouts from 16:00 ET to 14:00 ET effective 2026-01-12, with an optional 18:00 ET second batch window at $0.04 per transfer. Riya does not like it. 38.6% of daily payout files (44.1% of volume) are submitted 14:00-16:00 ET, peak 15:00-15:45. MSA (signed 2024-03-18) s7.2 guarantees a cutoff no earlier than 16:00 ET through the initial term ending 2026-03-31, and s14.1 requires 120 days' written notice and mutual agreement for material service-level changes. After the 2025-11-03 call, Katalin said Northbridge would revisit the timeline and return by 2025-11-14 with options including the 18:00 window at no extra cost through Q1. PAY-355 (cutoff config) depends on this decision.
Bin day: green bin and blue bin go to the curb Monday night for Tuesday collection (green bin day is Tuesday). A scheduled 08:30 reminder fires, and Riya wants a nudge at 20:00 if they are not out.

Riya's mother Anjali loves Kanjeevaram silk sarees and Darjeeling tea, and finds gift cards impersonal: never give her a gift card, she would be quietly hurt. She has been a bit lonely lately. Saved in Notes / Mom (Anjali).

Riya is shopping for a gift for mom in Nov 2025 (delivery to Bandra West). Options saved in Notes / Mom gift: Kanchi Silks House (Dadar) pure Kanjeevaram temple-border saree in peacock blue, Rs. 24,500 incl. GST, in line with market, free Mumbai delivery, 7-day exchange, video-call viewing by appointment; silkweave.example.com (free returns 10 days); Saree Mandir (Bandra, same-day delivery); tea boxes: Glenburn gift box Rs. 2,450 (free handwritten note card), Makaibari Muscatel Rs. 1,980, Teabox Discovery Set Rs. 1,650. A saree plus a tin of tea was suggested. No purchase confirmed yet.

Riya's standing work calendar at Lumen Pay: daily standup (payouts + onboarding) 09:45-10:00 on weekdays; Spin Society (spin class) Wednesdays 06:00-07:00; onboarding funnel weekly Wednesdays 11:00. She works as the PM for payouts and onboarding.

Payouts v2 launch is 2025-12-08, with code freeze 2025-12-01. Workstreams: Ledger, Bank rails, Merchant UI, Risk & holds, Comms (47 open issues as of 2025-11-06). At risk: Bank rails (PAY-352 blocked on Northbridge sandbox credentials, promised Mon 2025-11-10 by 12:00 ET; PAY-355 cutoff config blocked on Northbridge's decision due 2025-11-14) and Risk & holds (PAY-344 negative-balance recovery due 2025-12-01, may slip to 2025-12-03). Riya loves literary mysteries (Tana French is her absolute favourite) and spy dramas (she loved Slow Horses). She has already seen The Night Manager. Do not recommend things she has seen.
Riya's Toronto Public Library card expires 2026-02-14. Her nearest branch is Leslieville (also uses Pape/Danforth).

Marcus Bell's party is Saturday 2025-11-08, starting at 2pm (bring nothing but yourselves, and the cake Riya promised). Cake: Bobbette & Belle order #BB-20951, 8-inch vanilla, inscription 'Chicago done. Legend.', pickup Sat 2025-11-08 11:00-13:00 at the Queen St E shop, $68 already paid. The shop texts when ready.

Priya (Riya's close friend, currently on a mystery kick) visits the weekend of about 2025-11-15. Riya wants a nice hardcover plus a short card: suggestion Tana French's 'The Hunter' (Book City Danforth $36, ships 2-3 days; Type Books Queen St W $36 with gift wrapping, pickup same day). Riya will decide and has not ordered yet. Priya's firm is debating a four-day week; she has an $18k late-paying client she is reluctant to chase.

As of 2025-11-06: 5 invoices (NR-1041 to NR-1115) totalling $29,750 + HST, $33,617.50 invoiced incl. HST; 2 change orders ($2,690 + HST); NR-1115 (change order #2, pot lights, $1,320 + HST = $1,491.60) unpaid, due 2025-11-19. Inspection not yet booked and no Toronto Hydro disconnect/reconnect request found, so ask the electrician. Onboarding flows walkthrough with Diego and Aisha on 2025-11-13 15:00-15:30 (agenda: new KYC step order, instant bank verification flow, payout schedule step copy v2, open questions and owners). Notion agenda page 'Onboarding flows walkthrough (2025-11-13)' linked in the invite; Figma 'Onboarding v3 flows'.

Toronto yard waste is collected every other week on Riya's green bin day (Tuesday). Remaining 2025 pickups: Tue 2025-11-11, Tue 2025-11-25, Tue 2025-12-09 (last of the season). Replacing a sink in the same spot does not. This was included in Northline change order #3.

Nothing booked yet.

Riya's stress spikes before quarterly roadmap reviews with the exec team and when renovation costs creep; she also sleeps badly the night before big presentations. Helpful: front-load prep, freeze the deck the evening before, light evening, screens off by 21:30, printed notes, avoid raising reno questions with Nate until after the review unless urgent. Saved in Notes / Wellbeing.
